artifact_location.requirement: Caller-selected durable directory on the measured filesystem, outside temporary paths and shared-memory filesystems. References below are relative paths within that directory; the full local evidence is not embedded in these public summaries.

completion_deliverables: Five-repeat application/physical IOPS and depth/latency comparisons with paired observer qualification
Drive scaling curves with fresh adaptive decisions and honest capability limits
Actual exclusive CPU-site evidence and main-thread blocking attribution
Ranked focused changes with evidence, expected mechanism, tradeoffs and five-pair validation criteria
Canonical repository report, derived CSV/static plots, durable raw manifest and replay commands

data_preparation.data_variant: Regenerated post-reboot prepared data; new snapshot UUIDs are allowed and separately recorded.
data_preparation.old_vs_new_source_hashes: Compare each generated source Parquet against historical relative-path SHA oracles. Record all 1572 comparisons per task and preserve every difference; do not silently claim byte equality.
data_preparation.prepared_oracle: Generate new complete pristine owned-file manifests, source/config hashes and snapshot identifiers. Retain old prepared oracles as historical information, not acceptance authority for new data.
data_preparation.uuid_seed_caveat: Production snapshot/namespace identity can affect seeded training-table shuffle. The byte-identical native rebuild does not establish old/new seeded work or prediction equality on newly prepared UUIDs. Preserve production behavior and create new actual within-epoch reference rows.

adaptive_extensions.further_probes: Only after an explicit finite plan update based on fresh evidence.
adaptive_extensions.trigger: Use unchanged extension_blocks() at pinned ceiling source after complete fresh base70. Per block size: high-depth median gain above 5% OR median maximum issuer CPU at least 90%. These are protocol triggers, not significance tests.

drive_curve.fixture: Owned non-sparse regular file with retained CRC verification and SHA; no raw-device writes.
limits: A stable filesystem/device-path plateau does not isolate controller/media from kernel limits.
fio application outstanding is not measured physical queue occupancy.
Validate sysfs inflight behavior in this epoch before using it as occupancy evidence.
Uniform 4/8KiB random reads are not the full application locality/size mix or an SSD product rating.

launch_and_retention_gates: Root accepts each completed phase before next phase.
Fresh qualified runtime, data, fixture, templates, host/BTF/mount/health/resource snapshots and known-read collector smoke must exist before formal workload release.
Pin actual sources, loaded binaries, data identity, all effective controls and execution argv in every run.
No concurrent builds, fio, model profiles, ingest or heavy raw scans.
Fresh output roots; stop first error, preserve failed evidence, no automatic retry/resume or post-hoc pooling.
After payload completion and observer STOP/drain, persist raw events, records, service/collector/controller logs and hashes; fsync only owned files/directories outside timing before next payload.
Independent raw replay must verify lifecycle, counters, markers, identity, work/predictions and eligibility before accepting results.

phases.deliverable: Signed public recovery/rebuild provenance commit and root review
Regenerated source/prepared data, fio fixture, new full-work template oracles and collector smoke qualification
Fresh drive curve, two full actual profiles, principal70 matrix, independent raw replay, report/CSV/plots and action plan

metrics: Physical completed storage reads/s and bytes over measured phase windows
Native completed read/readv SQEs/s where available
Time-weighted block-visible dispatched depth and zero-depth duration
Request latency/size distributions and target-attribution bounds
Background traffic, CPU/resources, health and paired controls
principal70.order: Source-defined observer_order with order seed 20261109 within sequential groups.
principal70.overhead: Report all five paired training/E2E deltas per configuration and assess perturbation without a predeclared numeric cutoff or historical correction factor. Retain all observations and limitations.
principal70.queue_semantics: Block-visible dispatched requests are not NVMe internal/NAND occupancy; distinguish whole-device traffic and target-attribution bounds.
principal70.rate_semantics: Native read SQEs occur after native batching/coalescing and are not logical neighbor requests. mmap has no native SQE denominator; report its application rate as N/A.

acceptance: Loaded binary/source identity and exact phase markers
No loss, overflow, unknown lifecycle or undrained state
CPU sample/accounted-CPU and unwind coverage reported
Main-thread waits separated from overlapping idle-worker thread seconds
profiles.full_work: 1280 batches/optimizer updates and full workflow correctness checks.
profiles.interpretation: CPU and off-CPU are separate full runs; fractions are not exactly time-aligned or additive wall-clock shares. No unmeasured DRAM, controller or Python-operator bottleneck is asserted.

requirements.objective: Measure application request rates, physical storage IOPS, sustained block-visible depth/latency, drive capability scaling, and CPU/critical-thread waits; produce an evidence-based gap-closing plan.

source_plan_qualification: The retained local plan predates runtime qualification. This public plan resolves runtime status and explicitly includes the nine new full-work pilot template cells; later execution plans must record all actual paths and qualified hashes.

template_qualification.acceptance: Unchanged validator must establish native/config identity, equal logical seeded work/layout/model/predictions within each relevant new group and across compatible regimes. No shortened workload, old golden substitution, or source-level acceptance relaxation.
template_qualification.execution: Use unchanged native_io_matrix.py with --repetitions 1 --pilot and explicit full batch/update counts, controls, caches and memory budgets. Require complete fit, first/repeat/reload prediction checks.
template_qualification.lineage: Keep original archive inputs unchanged. Derived templates reference new prepared manifests and actual new result rows with recorded hashes and explicit path substitutions.
template_qualification.pilot_claim: Reference/oracle qualification only; n=1 pilots are not the five-pair performance result.
